welcome.title: Welcome to Vuko
welcome.text: Use binaural beats to guide yourself into different states of consciousness - meditation, focus, relaxation, or sleep.

step1.title: Step 1: Wear Headphones
step1.text: Binaural beats require stereo headphones to work. The left and right ears receive slightly different frequencies, creating a perceived beat in your brain.

step2.title: Step 2: Choose Your Music
step2.text: Select background music that helps you relax. You can search by mood (calm, focus) or instrument (piano, nature sounds).

step3.title: Step 3: Start Your Session
step3.text: Click 'Start' to begin. For the full experience, allow microphone access so we can adapt the beats to your breathing rhythm.
